FINAL("WITH pct AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         ((SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
          SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
         ) AS pct_increase
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND SUBSTR(y.Date,1,4) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT 'biggest' AS which, Segment
FROM (
  SELECT Segment
  FROM pct
  ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS top1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lowest' AS which, Segment
FROM (
  SELECT Segment
  FROM pct
  ORDER BY pct_increase ASC
  LIMIT 1
) AS bottom1;")
